remarks: **$25,000 PRICE REDUCTION.**  Welcome to this beautifully remodeled center hall Colonial, ideally located in the heart of Westport, CT. This stunning home boasts high ceilings and an open floor plan that seamlessly blends modern design with classic charm. The sun-drenched, fully updated kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring quality finishes and top-of-the-line appliances. Upstairs recreation room has an additional bunk room/bedroom. With a spacious 3-car garage and a beautifully landscaped, private backyard, this property is perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Conveniently close to top-rated schools, the vibrant downtown area, local beaches, and train, it offers the best of Westport living. Move-in ready just in time for the holidays!
